verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce documents agent payment calls: purchase-intent mandates (POST /acp/v1/instructions), card tokenization, and credential retrieval scoped to a merchant and total amount. None of these is a documented call to create or update a cart or order draft. The purchase intent is a spend-authorization mandate with a decline threshold, not a line-item cart. The Agent Toolkit's invoice and payment-link tools are adjacent payment-request features, not cart or order-draft management.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can create and update a cart or order draft through a documented protocol call
